Normal B cells:


Lymphoma B cells:
```{r}
GSE171424 <- read_csv("X:/Labs/Oakes/Illumina_Methylation_Arrays/3-Processed data/from EPIC V1/867K Processed/867K BMIQ GSE171424.csv")
GSE171424 <- as.data.frame(GSE171424)
rownames(GSE171424) <- GSE171424$ID
GSE171424 <- GSE171424[,-1]

annotation_GSE171424 <- read_csv("X:/Labs/Oakes/Illumina_Methylation_Arrays/1-Raw Data/EPIC V1 (850K) Raw Data/GSE171424_RAW/annotation.csv")
```

```{r}
annotation_GSE171424 <- annotation_GSE171424[match(annotation_GSE171424$Sample_Name, colnames(GSE171424)),]
annotation_GSE174666 <- annotation_GSE174666[match(annotation_GSE174666$Sample_Name, colnames(GSE174666)),]
```

```{r}
colnames(GSE171424) <- annotation_GSE171424$sampleid
colnames(GSE174666) <- annotation_GSE174666$sampleid
```
